functionality.rationale: Manifest-level transfer state must preserve per-entry ordering, integrity, partial outcomes, and one-file compatibility.

security.rationale: A stream-to-entry mismatch or incomplete manifest validation could redirect writes or bypass aggregate limits.

performance.rationale: Large manifests and many small files must not create unbounded per-entry state or repeated full-manifest work.

compatibility.rationale: Manifest commitments and existing one-file protocol behavior must remain compatible with protocol v1.

concurrency.rationale: Multiple entry streams, cancellation, failure, commit, and connection teardown race within one transfer.

platform.rationale: Directory and file orchestration consumes platform storage behavior across all supported desktop filesystems.

persistence.rationale: Partial manifest outcomes must commit only verified entries and clean every uncommitted storage transaction.

adr.rationale: The task implements accepted protocol v1 manifest behavior and XT-033 storage contracts.

architecture.rationale: Multi-file orchestration remains within the canonical transfer module.

roadmap.rationale: XT-039 accepts the complete production behavior after adapters, UI, and platform evidence.
